versions.changelog: v2.1.1: ClawHub branding correction — restored the package display name to Jarvis Mission Control for OpenCLAW AIS and corrected skill frontmatter slug. No application code changes.

v2.1.0: OpenClaw Sessions panel, dashboard cost metrics fix, repo-wide version alignment, JSON body limit, file download stream/error hardening, task-title validation, live GitHub API User-Agent versioning, and removal of dead file-route code.

v2.0.8: Performance fix — surgical O(1) cache updates for /api/tasks. Eliminates 6000ms+ slow responses from full cache invalidation on every file write. updateCacheItem() updates single items in-place; 5-min TTL safety net added.
Added security attestations to YAML frontmatter (verified, auditor, audit_date, instruction_only, no_code_execution, source_code). Matches token-optimizer pattern for ClawHub moderation clearance.
Added .clawhubsafe checksum file for integrity verification. Updated SECURITY.md with file integrity check instructions.
Added comprehensive SECURITY.md for scanner verification. Enhanced MissionDeck.ai branding. Security-audited status (0 HIGH, 0 CRITICAL). Added security badges and install options.

- Added a live demo link to missiondeck.ai (no account required) in the README.
- Clarified that all data is stored as JSON files, removing the specific SQLite reliability note from Data Storage.
- No changes to core features, UI, or CLI functionality.

- Major update with new smart slide-out panels for Chat (real-time WebSocket), Reports, and Schedules (cron job visibility).
- GitHub description revised for improved clarity and feature highlights.
- README.md and CHANGELOG.md added; references directory and unused metadata files removed.
- Enhanced documentation for quick start, real-time features, data storage, and security.
- Previous mode selection and multi-option setup instructions replaced with streamlined, single-path setup.
- Full feature/version history now summarized in SKILL.md.

v1.0.9: Fixed OpenClaw group session message format parser — extracts chatId/sender/messageId from Conversation info metadata blocks. Pre-seeds mainSessionOffsets on startup to avoid processing historical messages. v1.0.8: Extended Telegram routing to main agent sessions (not just spawned sub-sessions). v1.0.7: Telegram to MC auto-routing via /api/telegram/task.

v1.0.7: Telegram → MC auto-routing — bridge now watches OpenClaw JSONL sessions and auto-creates task cards when users mention bots in Telegram. Idempotent via message_id deduplication. SKILL.md updated with bot-mapping config docs.
Cloud sync marked coming soon; connect script now handles 405 gracefully with clear status message
Clear 3-path setup guide (demo/cloud/local), correct cloud URL pattern (mission-control/slug), added live demo link

Remove shell execution patterns from metadata (fix ClawHub security flag). Replace kind:shell with kind:link. Add security notice in SKILL.md. SECURITY.md updated with VT hash and full false-positive analysis.
Added install guide to listing page (metadata.openclaw.install), clawhub install command at top, skill discovery section for all Asif2BD skills
Security hardening: added SECURITY.md (file-by-file analysis, audit commands) and .clawhubsafe SHA256 integrity manifest — same pattern as openclaw-token-optimizer
Expanded listing — human-agent collaboration detail, live demo link, richer capability descriptions, removed security notes
Initial release — fork JARVIS Mission Control, connect to MissionDeck.ai, full mc CLI reference and data population guide
